item.title: Pow Wow Life Archives
item.description: What happens when you combine design talent, Indigenous identity, humor, and a sharp eye for what’s missing in the market? You get Born of Legends. This week on Pow Wow Life, Shannon Romero shares how she built her brand, why contemporary Native representation matters, and how she created designs that reflect shared Indigenous experiences. We also get into the business side, including how Etsy helped her launch and grow her work into something bigger.Follow Born of Legendswww.bornoflegends.comIn
